prompt: Which class is used to load an image from a file in Swing?
explanation: ImageIO.read(File) loads an image file (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP) and returns a BufferedImage. Example: BufferedImage img = ImageIO.read(new File("photo.png")); Wrap in try-catch for IOException. To load from a classpath resource: ImageIO.read(getClass().getResource("/images/sprite.png"));
